description: What a brand was alerted about (each thread once), newest first; or, with mark_read_ids, mark alerts as taken so unread=true shows only what is left. Poll with since = your last read every 10 to 30 minutes, or set a webhook with viralhunt_brand_webhook.

mark_read_ids.description: Mark these alert ids as taken (a POST instead of the list).

unread.description: true = only alerts not yet marked read.

name: viralhunt_brand_alerts
